name: Turnip Casserole
description: A savory turnip casserole with apples and a crunchy bread crumb topping, perfect for freezing.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the mashed turnip, pepper, chopped apples (if using), eggs, butter, and salt in a bowl. Mix well.
Transfer the turnip mixture to a buttered ovenproof casserole dish.
Prepare the topping by mixing the bread crumbs with the melted butter until well combined.
Sprinkle the bread crumb mixture evenly over the top of the casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350 °F for 45 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

keywords: turnip casserole, bread crumb topping, savory side dish, freezer-friendly

_similar.name: Sweet Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A classic sweet potato casserole with a crunchy pecan topping.

recipeInstructions.text: Peel, cut up, and boil the sweet potatoes until tender. Mash to make 3 cups.
Stir in the beaten eggs, melted butter, evaporated milk, and vanilla into the mashed sweet potatoes. Mix well.
Pour the sweet potato mixture into a baking dish.
Prepare the topping by mixing together the pecans, brown sugar, flour, and melted butter until crumbly.
Sprinkle the topping evenly over the sweet potato mixture.
Bake at 350 °F for 40 minutes.

_similar.keywords: sweet potato casserole, pecan topping, holiday side dish

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Hamburger Pie
_similar.description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Macaroni Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting macaroni and ham casserole topped with cheddar cheese and crushed sour cream and onion potato chips.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 1¼ cups (250 to 375 mL) grated cheddar cheese
Crushed sour cream and onion flavoured potato chips for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cook the macaroni in boiling water, then drain and mix in cubed ham.
Melt margarine in a saucepan and mix in the flour. Add in the milk and stir constantly over medium heat until the mixture is thick and smooth.
Mix the sauce with the macaroni and ham, then pour into a greased casserole dish.
Add salt and pepper to taste, and stir in about ¾ of the grated cheddar cheese.
Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese on top.
Top with crushed sour cream and onion flavoured potato chips.
Bake at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the casserole is bubbling.

_similar.keywords: macaroni casserole, ham and cheese, comfort food
